name: personal-assistant-mesh
description: Owner-bound local Mesh task submission, status and approved results. Adds managed capabilities without intercepting native tools.

interface.longDescription: Submit retained-ID owner tasks, inspect metadata-only status and retrieve owner-approved results through an owner-installed local runtime. No worker enrollment, credential discovery or native tool restrictions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use my Mesh for an authorized task; retain its request ID and check the original task's status and approved result.
